site.title: MMIR
site.subtitle: The orchestration layer for trusted AI.
site.heroDescription: MMIR connects local AI, model routing, workflows, memory and trusted runtimes from one control plane. Open mmir.ai, connect local AI, install, ready.
site.promptWorkflow: Use MMIR as the control plane above models: connect local runtimes, choose safe routes, automate workflows and keep secrets out of the public frontend.
